owner_statement: LIGHT / WHITE creative backgrounds are strongly preferred as the normal Advantage.Bid advertising environment. The dark Notable Lot treatment was too dark; the light recreation was substantially preferred. Warm authentic interiors, lightly coloured environments, soft photographic backgrounds and controlled environmental imagery are acceptable when the overall creative remains bright and readable. RED is an important attention colour: it pops, attracts the eye, creates emphasis, adds energy, and works for CTAs, underlines, event-type emphasis, key words and controlled accents. Use red selectively; do not flood. Do not over-constrain into navy-only.
formula: LIGHT FOUNDATION + NAVY AUTHORITY + RED ATTENTION + MERCHANDISE COLOUR — a strong preference, not a rigid formula

light_grounds: soft photographic light interiors with mean luminance ≥ 0.62 in the copy zone

light_foundation.measure: mean luminance of the canvas excluding the navy band ≥ 0.60 AND the copy zone ≥ 0.72
light_foundation.evidence: all 10 new references; the dark Notable Lot version rejected
light_foundation.note: a warm interior on one side is light foundation if these hold (REF-14/15/18–21 all pass)

navy_authority.rule: navy is the structural colour; it is never the attention colour

where: ONE red word or line inside the headline (FINDS; Lot; Results.; Estate Sale)
the rule/swash under the headline or script
red_attention.budget: at most 3 red elements above the band (headline word/line, CTA, one rule or swash) + red icon discs as one group; red share of saturated pixels in the copy zone 35–65% (measured 50–60% across REF-14, 18–23); never a red ground, never a red band, never red body copy
red_attention.evidence: 6 of 8 Advantage.Bid-led new references use a red CTA; every one uses a red rule or swash

logo_blue_secondary.rule: the logo's own blue may be used as a secondary accent (a headline line, icon discs, a corner panel) — REF-15/16/17 are Owner-approved with it; it never replaces red as the CTA/attention colour by default and never becomes a blue ground
logo_blue_secondary.evidence: 3 of 10 new references; the Owner's 3M statement against app blue as PRIMARY brand blue still stands — blue is secondary

merchandise_colour.rule: unchanged from 3M: colour comes from real merchandise; grounds and panels stay quiet

dark_treatments.allowed_when: one lit/translucent/reflective hero object where darkness makes the light visible (REF-12) AND the Director records the reason AND Owner review is flagged for the first uses
dark_treatments.not_allowed: as a Notable Lot default (Owner rejected the dark Bronze Horse), as a 'premium' cue, or to hide weak merchandise
dark_treatments.family_change: SINGLE_LOT ground default = white/very_light (was dark-permitted in 3P.1 prominence/family rules); dark_hero requires the reason above

hard: red element count ≤ 3 above the band
soft: red share of saturated pixels band
navy present in headline or band
